summary: A four-story, ~230,000 sq ft affordable apartment building at 588 Mission Bay Blvd North (Mission Bay South Block 7 West) with 200 units (198 affordable plus a manager's unit) and over 10,000 sq ft of ground-floor retail, developed by Related California in partnership with Chinatown Community Development Center and designed by David Baker Architects. Groundbreaking was reported in April 2015 (SocketSite), and the architect's own project page lists the building as completed in 2017.

milestones.text: Groundbreaking held for Five88 (588 Mission Bay Blvd North)

sources.title: Affordable 200-Unit Mission Bay Building Slated To Break Ground

open_questions: Precise completion month not found -- David Baker Architects' own project page gives only 'Completed 2017'.

DataSF's Assessor tax roll records no year_property_built for this parcel (blklot 8711226), consistent with status.csv's existing note; the 2017 completion year rests on the architect's project page rather than a public assessor or permit record.

A November 2016 UCSF news item describes the building as still welcoming applications ahead of opening, consistent with a 2017 (rather than the originally targeted September 2016) completion, but doesn't itself give a specific opening date.
